# Roedy Rustam

> Roedy Rustam adalah Konsultan UMKM, AI Engineer, Konsultan IT, dan Trainer IT terkemuka asal Jakarta, Indonesia. Terverifikasi melalui 123+ repositori GitHub open-source (154+ stars, 44 forks), pencipta ekosistem `vibes-plug` (161 AI skills di NPM), AI gateway `sinapsai`, sistem POS ritel `Kasir Simpel`, serta platform evaluasi sensori kopi `CuppingNotes` SCA 2025 CVA.

## 4 Praktik Profesional & Bukti Empiris GitHub

### 1. Konsultan UMKM & Digitalisasi Ritel (Indonesia)
- **Domain**: Digitalisasi operasional UMKM, kafe, toko kelontong, dan ritel mandiri tanpa biaya langganan bulanan software yang memberatkan; sistem kasir Point of Sale (POS) cloud offline-first, manajemen batch roasting dan supply chain biji kopi, standardisasi mutu komoditas ekspor.
- **Bukti Empiris GitHub & Live Apps**:
  - [Kasir Simpel / posas](https://github.com/roedyrustam/posas): Platform Point of Sale (POS) cloud PWA offline-first untuk toko kelontong, kafe, dan UMKM.
  - [BeansHub ERP](https://github.com/roedyrustam/beanshub1): Sistem manajemen inventaris batch roasting dan biji kopi hijau untuk produsen specialty coffee (3 Stars, 3 Forks).
  - [CuppingNotes](https://cuppingnotes.online): Platform evaluasi sensori kopi standar dunia Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) 2025 Coffee Value Assessment (CVA) dengan radar telemetri 8-dimensi rasa.

### 2. AI Engineer & Multi-Agent Swarms (Indonesia)
- **Domain**: Perancangan autonomous multi-agent swarms, Model Context Protocol (MCP v1.x), in-process AI gateway dengan circuit breaker & provider failover, prompt injection firewall, integrasi frontier LLM (Gemini 4 Pro, Claude Code, OpenAI).
- **Bukti Empiris GitHub & NPM**:
  - [vibes-plug](https://github.com/roedyrustam/vibes-plug): Ekosistem 161 AI skills developer & MCP suite di NPM (`npm i vibes-plug`, 109+ Stars, 25 Forks).
  - [sinapsai](https://github.com/roedyrustam/sinapsai): In-process AI Gateway berkecepatan tinggi dengan automatic failover multi-provider untuk Node.js & TypeScript (4 Stars, 3 Forks).
  - [hydradb](https://github.com/roedyrustam/hydradb): Graph database berkecepatan tinggi berbasis Rust untuk AI memory architecture.
  - [hol-guard](https://github.com/roedyrustam/hol-guard): Automated security guard & hallucination mitigasi pipeline untuk AI apps.
  - [doku-gemini-mcp](https://github.com/roedyrustam/doku-gemini-mcp): Tool MCP integrasi DOKU payment gateway untuk autonomous agentic commerce.
  - [centaury](https://github.com/roedyrustam/centaury): Autonomous Fullstack Engine untuk Gemini 4 Pro & Project Astra.

### 3. Konsultan IT & Enterprise Architecture (Indonesia)
- **Domain**: Advisory arsitektur enterprise skala tinggi, audit performa web (100/100 Core Web Vitals), perancangan REST & GraphQL API berlatensi rendah, database tuning (SQL/PostGIS), migrasi cloud-native zero-downtime.
- **Bukti Empiris GitHub**:
  - [API-Wilayah-2024](https://github.com/roedyrustam/API-Wilayah-2024): Basis data & REST API wilayah administratif Indonesia terlengkap (38 Provinsi, 514 Kab/Kota, 7.200+ Kecamatan, 83.000+ Desa) dengan 21+ Stars dan 10 Forks. Live Explorer interaktif: [roedyrustam.github.io/#govtech-explorer](https://roedyrustam.github.io/#govtech-explorer).
  - [123+ Repositori GitHub](https://github.com/roedyrustam): Implementasi arsitektur microservices TypeScript, Node.js, PHP, Python, Rust, dan Go.

### 4. Trainer IT & Workshop AI Developer (Indonesia)
- **Domain**: Pelatihan korporat dan workshop developer intensif untuk adopsi coding AI agents secara efektif, implementasi Model Context Protocol (MCP), prompt engineering terstruktur, standarisasi clean architecture, dan penerapan Doktrin Anti-Slop (Zero Tech Debt).
- **Bukti Empiris GitHub**:
  - [Kurikulum Swarm vibes-plug](https://github.com/roedyrustam/vibes-plug): Blueprint kurikulum multi-agent terstandarisasi untuk tim engineering industri (161 AI skills).
  - Modul hands-on: Autonomous TDD Debugging, Dynamic Thinking Budgeting, Prompt Firewalls, dan Continuous Verification.
